firstPlayerRule: Randomly select a Leader, who takes the Leader token and proposes the first Mission Team.
clarifications: If a proposed Mission Team is rejected, leadership passes clockwise and team building is repeated.
After each Mission, the Leader token passes clockwise for the next round.

internalEvidence: Downloaded the Indie Boards & Cards consolidated rules v1.1 (retailer-hosted copy of the publisher document; footer on page 25 names indieboardsandcards.com and the consolidated-rules version) and extracted text from pages 2, 4, 5 and 6. Page 2: 'Randomly select a Leader; the Leader receives the Leader Token.' Pages 4-5: the Leader passes clockwise after a rejected team and after each Mission. Contents list a Leader Token and Vote Tokens, matching the current token-based base game (BGG 41114); an older card-based rulebook (cdn.1j1ju.com) gives the same random-Leader instruction. The publisher product page links no rules PDF. SHA-256: 8a8da8145b5fb786a012d7c8aac3257bab99662d8ee70e076ae4554068d6da9d. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25. Editorial review 2026-09-25: Rechecked the source pages, opening instruction, game identity, and edition.
